lines.en: label kirinchristmalloween1:
Haruka Hamasaki was a human being living on a planet called “Earth.”
lines.zh: Haruka Hamasaki 是一个生活在叫做“地球”的行星上的人类。

lines.en: And for a number of reasons, many of which she did not understand nor {i}care{/i} to understand, she was attracted to teenage girls.
lines.zh: 出于种种她既不理解、也{i}不屑{/i}去理解的理由，她对十几岁的少女抱有欲望。

lines.en: Never in a million years did she think she’d be brazen enough to act on that. But after years of watching her master work his magic, she felt inspired enough to try pulling a rabbit from a hat.
lines.zh: 她万万没想到自己会有胆子真的付诸行动。但在旁观了主人施展魔法这么多年之后，她觉得自己受到了足够的鼓舞，想试着从帽子里拽出一只兔子来。

lines.en: Magic isn’t something that comes easy, though. It takes time and practice — and an audience both aloof and trusting enough to not ask questions.
lines.zh: 不过魔法从来不是什么容易的事。它需要时间和练习——还需要一群既冷淡又足够信任、不会发问的观众。

lines.en: Kirin Kanda, another human being living on the same planet as Haruka Hamasaki, was currently kicking herself for {i}not{/i} asking more questions.
lines.zh: Kirin Kanda，另一个和 Haruka Hamasaki 生活在同一颗行星上的人类，此刻正因为自己{i}没有{/i}多问几句而懊恼不已。

lines.en: She had come a long way in {i}different{/i} ways from Haruka lately. And it was a way she never would have come at all if excitement and curiosity did not light the path.
lines.zh: 她最近以{i}另一种{/i}方式走了很远。而如果不是兴奋与好奇照亮了前路，她根本一步都不会走上这条路。

lines.en: Unfortunately, once the lights of the bathroom she was dragged into were flicked off, these qualities could not find and guide her.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，当她被拖进去的那间洗手间的灯被关掉之后，这两种特质便找不到她、也无法再引导她了。

lines.en: It was just dark. Darker {i}still{/i} in the confines of a tidy bathroom stall where she was subsequently pressed up against the door.
lines.zh: 只是一片黑暗。在一个整洁的洗手间隔间里更{i}暗{/i}，而她随后被压在了那扇门上。

lines.en: That was fine, though. For just like when she lost her virginity, she was content with being used because it meant someone wanted to use her.
lines.zh: 不过没关系。就像失去初夜那次一样，她甘愿被使用，因为那意味着有人想要使用她。

lines.en: She was mad too. Mad that {i}he{/i} wasn’t here to press her up against the door instead. Mad that he’d let someone else get to her when he knew the type of girl she was.
lines.zh: 她也愤怒。愤怒于{i}他{/i}没在这里把她压在门上。愤怒于他明知她是哪种女孩，却让别人碰了她。

lines.en: Filthy.
lines.zh: 肮脏。

lines.en: Weak.
lines.zh: 软弱。

lines.en: Undesirable.
lines.zh: 不讨人喜欢。

lines.en: Selfish.
lines.zh: 自私。

lines.en: And yet...
lines.zh: 然而……

lines.en: And yet the temptation to {i}submit{/i} to temptation couldn’t match the power with which she longed to jostle the handle and free herself from this prison of her own creation.
lines.zh: 然而，{i}屈服{/i}于诱惑的冲动，终究敌不过她想要撞开那扇门的把手、把自己从这座亲手造出的牢笼里放出去的渴望。

lines.en: But that, too, was a power insurmountable for a girl this weak — who’d given up long before mentioning giving up at all.
lines.zh: 但那同样是一种这个软弱的女孩无法企及的力量——她早在开口说要放弃之前，就已经放弃了。

lines.en: She would live in this cell — not thrive, but live — eating scraps passed through the bars and spreading her legs for “routine checks” because even that was better than sitting in silence.
lines.zh: 她会活在这间牢房里——不算活得好，只是活着——吃着从栏杆间递进来的残渣，并在“例行检查”时张开双腿，因为就连那也比坐在沉默里好。

lines.en: Kirin Kanda was a human being living on a planet called “Earth” pressed up against the door of a dark bathroom stall who was filthy, weak, undesirable, selfish, and hated silence.
lines.zh: Kirin Kanda 是一个生活在叫做“地球”的行星上的人类，被压在一间黑暗洗手间隔间的门上，她肮脏、软弱、不讨人喜欢、自私，并且憎恨沉默。

lines.en: But screaming is unbecoming. And screaming would be a proclamation that she’s better than what she is when she knows that she is not.
lines.zh: 但尖叫有失体面。而尖叫等于宣告自己比真实的自己更好——可她知道自己并不更好。

lines.en: So she just looks away and lets the woman who brought her here do the dirty work...
lines.zh: 于是她只是别过头，任由那个把她带到这里的女人做那些下流的事……

lines.en: Hoping that this, too, will be something she grows into.
lines.zh: 希望这也会是她终将习惯的东西。

lines.en: And that the moment she’s found herself in is not a nightmare at all, for the nightmares come later.
lines.zh: 也祈愿她此刻身处的这个瞬间根本不是噩梦，因为噩梦还在后面。

lines.en: This is something else.
lines.zh: 这是别的什么。

lines.en: This is purgatory.
lines.zh: 这是炼狱。
